_comment: Mobile performance budgets for e2e/mobile-budget.spec.ts (Global Footer E2E workflow, production build, 375px, unauthenticated). The registry covers all thirteen non-Social World menu roots. jsKb = transferred script bytes before load; lcpMs = Largest Contentful Paint. A row may only go DOWN, with one recorded exception below. `converted: true` also enforces the 12px text floor and 44px tap targets on that route; flip it in the phase PR that converts the page (docs/mobile-standard/ROLLOUT-PLAN.md). Baselines 2026-09-03 (branch before the Sentry integration): jsKb 635-711 across the original ten routes. Re-baselined 2026-09-04 after merging main: the SHARED framework chunk grew about 100KB on every route (Sentry, #1315), measured jsKb 740-817, LCP 272-1068ms on a Mac. That growth belongs to the app shell, not to any page, so every row was raised once to sit above it (converted 850, unconverted 900); from here rows only go down.
